prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite strip for American Girl Doll Race. Image 1 is the approved IDENTITY and CLOTHES reference only. Create exactly THREE separate full-body depictions of this same doll in ONE horizontal canvas exactly 3:1 aspect ratio (three equal square cells), no grid or text. Dark brown skin, warm brown eyes, shoulder dark ringlets, magenta satin bow headband and dance dress with black ruffle sleeves, black waistband and 3 black ruffled hem tiers, silver Mary Jane shoes with black bows. Graceful dancer, springy confident movement. Match rounded vinyl toy face, inset eyes, sturdy childlike 18-inch doll proportions, molded hands, rooted hair and miniature sewn fabrics. Left: neutral standing, arms relaxed at sides, frontal three-quarter toward right. Middle: tiny weight shift, same standing height. Right: lively anticipatory stance, same standing height. Every doll wholly inside its own square, with generous 10% margins, no touching, same head size and bodily scale throughout, feet at common low baseline. Hair stays compact. True clean transparent background throughout, NO glow or gradient, no floor, shadow, scenery, text or props. The reference background must not be carried over.
